title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
lede: Corma, an AI cybersecurity startup that came out of stealth in August, raised a $125 million Series A led by NEA at a $1 billion valuation.

points: Corma builds AI models and agents trained for security defence and presents itself as a frontier research lab focused on protection.
Total funding stands at $185 million, with Sequoia Capital, Khosla Ventures and Coatue among its backers.
Demand jumped after October 21, when flaws in PHP and Node.js and a LiteLLM security incident all surfaced on the same day.
It competes with Kevin Mandia's Armadin, Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft and many other startups in AI-driven defence.

sections.text: The October 21 incidents hit tools found in many AI stacks, LiteLLM among them, and investors are now paying for defence that can keep pace with AI-assisted attacks.
